mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.0% indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic contraction that triggers a risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), a rising CPI signals the central bank will tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods meeting the trigger condition, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the CPIAUCSL signal in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing and industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a central bank's response to inflationary pressures through rate cuts, which typically leads to positive equity returns as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 95.0), a low level of industrial production signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
